prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several unexpected winning updates performed better than predicted.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path hint, choose_path new_flow, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) were helpful, winning in 6 of 10 tests (+9.4%, +5.6%, +4.3%, +4.4%, +3.1%, and +2.4%), while 4 showed no clear effect.
Sign-in wait info (sign_in wait_info) updates were consistently helpful, winning in both tests (+3.0% and +7.3%).
Home wait info (home wait_info) changes were helpful in 4 of 12 tests (+4.2%, +4.0%, +2.6%, and +2.7%), while the remaining 8 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign and sign-in reordering (sign_in reorder) consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests each.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Speech & Chat Simulation Flow: Add an interactive dialogue simulation flow on the home intro screen that allows users to test sending messages and receiving responses from their desktop pet before finishing setup. (why: Support receives multiple tickets from users confused about how to talk to or interact with their pet after onboarding. Finish interactive flows have won in 6 out of 10 prior tests.)
1: [sign_in, wait_info] Cloud Sync and Multi-Session Account Restore Status Info: Display a sign-in sync status banner clarifying that logging in preserves existing pets and prevents account resets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again. Sign-in wait info updates have consistently won in previous tests (+3.0% and +7.3%).)
2: [sign_in, wait_info] Account Session Verification & Recovery Wait Status Display: Display a real-time account verification status indicator on the sign-in step to inform users that credential verification is actively running. (why: 2 support tickets noted that the sign-in screen stalled or failed to appear. Sign-in wait info changes have proven consistently effective in tests.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay and Screen Layering Readiness Status Monitor: Show a desktop rendering layer and screen placement readiness status monitor during the waiting step. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show up on desktop upon launch. Home wait info changes have successfully improved conversion in 4 previous tests.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Behavior & Mood Adjustment Guided Flow: Add an interactive behavior tuning widget on home_intro allowing users to set pet idle actions and desktop activity preferences before launching. (why: 4 support emails cited desktop feature misbehavior after setup. Adding an interactive finish flow allows users to configure behavior upfront.)
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Pose & Framing Quality Preparation Hint: Add a photo preparation quality hint on the photo upload screen explaining optimal framing and lighting for custom pet creation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results, contributing to low conversion (72.3%) at the adoption step.)
6: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Control Bar Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen using a card layout featuring direct interactive control action buttons for hiding, moving, and talking to the pet. (why: Users reported confusion post-onboarding on how to interact with their pets. Finish screen redesign with card structure highlights essential controls.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Desktop Companion Path Capability Guidance Hint: Include a helpful guidance hint on choose_path clarifying what each companion path offers before selection. (why: Choose_path has a high mean duration (514s), suggesting users hesitate when choosing a path. Providing clear guidance reduces friction.)
8: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Pet Render Diagnostic Verification Status Info: Add real-time render diagnostic verification status indicators on the adoption certificate screen while asset details populate. (why: Adoption step has the lowest step conversion rate in the onboarding funnel (72.3%). Displaying active status info keeps users engaged during generation.)

scores.note: Interactive finish flows have a high historical win rate (6/10 tests, +2.9% average lift), though finish step already has high baseline conversion.
Strong alignment between support tickets (8 emails) and proven sign_in wait_info pattern (+5.2% avg relative gain). Low implementation cost.
Sign-in wait info updates consistently perform well across tests, supporting user confidence during credentials verification.
Home step conversion is already high (94.2%), and home wait_info changes show mixed historical results (4/12 wins).
Interactive finish flow pattern is effective (+2.9% avg), but developing a new tuning widget requires new screen development.
Adoption step has the highest user drop-off (72.3% conversion). Hints have moderate historic gains (+0.9%) at minimal effort.
Redesigns carry high risk of performance degradation across historical tests and require a full release.
Addresses long step duration, but choose_path hints previously showed no positive impact (-0.2% in prior test).
Targets the biggest funnel bottleneck (adoption 72.3%) with a pattern that delivered +3.7% in prior tests.
